title: China Visa-Free in 2026: Every Rule & the Mistakes That Void It
description:
More people can enter China without a visa in 2026 than at almost any point in modern history — but the rules are a maze, and a few small mistakes can get you turned around at the border. This is the full breakdown: the two visa-free systems, exactly who qualifies, and the mistakes that quietly void your entry — with an expert tip at the end that makes visa-free China actually usable.

We cover the 30-day unilateral visa-free entry, the 240-hour (10-day) visa-free transit, the third-country onward-ticket rule, the region-and-port limits, the midnight clock, and the one thing that changes constantly — so you know exactly what to verify before you fly.

This is general travel information, not legal advice, and China's entry rules change frequently. Always confirm the current rules with China's National Immigration Administration (nia.gov.cn) or your nearest Chinese embassy within a few days of your trip.
